{{Top|leg}}
A '''stun field''' was a security measure used to secure cargo. [[Electronic Freightways]], a mysterious shipping company that contracted [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] exclusively through electronic means, often protected their cargo with stun fields to dissuade shippers from breaking into their crates.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
